title: AtriaAssessment
description: The system's recommendation for one patient — the output of the orchestrator after guardrails, inference, and comparison with the nurse's blind ESI. Shape matches PRD §10.2.

stage.description: Where the blind-assessment workflow currently is.

cycle.description: How many times this patient has been reassessed from scratch.

nurse_esi.description: The nurse's blind ESI selection. Null only before they choose.

revealed.description: False while ATRIA is locked. When false, no recommendation field exists in this payload.

guardrail.description: True if a Layer 0 red flag fired on recorded values.

atria_esi.description: ATRIA's recommended ESI. Null when abstained. ABSENT (not null) before reveal.

atria_abstained.description: True when ATRIA refused to score (insufficient data or ambiguous presentation).

outcome.description: Result of comparing nurse ESI with ATRIA recommendation.

needs_reason.description: True when the nurse must provide a structured reason before sign-off.

final_esi.description: The signed-off ESI after the nurse confirms. Null until signed.

reason_code.description: Structured reason code when the nurse diverges from ATRIA.

probabilities.description: Calibrated class probabilities from the inference service.

reason_codes.description: Plain-language reasons from a fixed vocabulary. Never free text.
